en.title: Luna Bloom Society maternity community
en.brief: Maternity communities default to high-volume social mechanics. The concept had to hold long-form editorial and peer conversation without the pull of an endless feed.
decisions: Stories arrive in small, complete sets — ending the page is a feature, not a failure.
Open comment threads replaced by small trimester rooms with a guide present.
Long-form journal pieces lead the experience, so membership is asked for after trust is earned.
en.outcome: A complete concept — feed, community rooms, editorial studio and events — in one design language, built from twelve component families over six weeks and ready to extend into a product build.

zh.meta: 社区平台 · 概念作品
zh.title: Luna Bloom Society 母婴社区
zh.brief: 母婴社区通常依赖高频社交机制。这个概念要在没有无限信息流的前提下，同时容纳长文内容和用户之间的交流。
decisions: 内容以小批完整的形式呈现，页面有明确结尾，而不是无限下拉。
取消公开评论，改为按孕期分组的小型房间，并配有引导者。
长文放在最前，先建立信任，再谈会员转化。
zh.outcome: 一套完整概念：信息流、社区房间、内容工作室和活动模块统一在同一设计语言下，由十二个组件族构成，六周完成，可直接延伸到产品开发。

en.title: Softness as a design system.
en.lede: A maternity community concept built to hold long-form editorial and peer conversation without the pull of an endless feed.

facts.label: Deliverables
facts.value: Feed, community rooms, editorial studio, events

en.brief: Luna Bloom Society asked for a digital home that feels like a held breath: calm, luminous and intimate. Maternity platforms default to high-volume social mechanics, and the brief ruled those out from the start.
en.briefTwo: The problem was structural rather than visual — how to run a community without infinite scroll, open comment threads or engagement counters, and still give members a reason to return.
decisions: Stories arrive in small, complete sets. Ending the page is a feature: members leave calm rather than drained.
Open comment threads were replaced by small trimester rooms with a guide present, so conversation stays high-touch.
Long-form journal pieces lead the experience, so the brand earns trust before it asks for membership.
en.outcome: A complete concept — feed, community rooms, editorial studio and events — expressed in one design language across twelve component families, ready to extend into a full product build.

en.title: Ion Forge X9 product launch system
en.brief: A hardware launch page has to carry industrial design, spec detail and motion in one view, then repeat across twelve regional markets without a rebuild.
decisions: A metal material system with defined macro and micro states, so surfaces stay consistent at every crop.
Motion held in tokens — pulse, scan and hover are declared once and reused.
A localisation layer separating copy and telemetry overlays from layout.
en.outcome: Seventy-four components and eighteen scenes covering twelve markets, with the design and engineering stack documented as one delivery blueprint.

decisions: 金属材质系统定义了宏观与微观两种状态，任意裁切下表面表现一致。
动效以 token 形式管理，脉冲、扫描、悬停各定义一次并复用。
本地化层把文案与遥测叠层从布局中分离出来。
